items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I worked with Phil Woods, I worked with his group with Gene Quill.

ctx.x: Yeah I’d like to see if it’s the same one I have because that piano sounds better here than it does on mine. Anyhow during that record date, I don’t even know how I got on the date because I hadn’t met Benny Carter before then. I knew everybody else in the band, except John Collins, I didn’t know him, but I had played with Jimmy Garrison, with Philly Joe, I had worked with Jo Jones a lot, I worked with Phil Woods, I worked with his group with Gene Quill. And Charlie Rouse I don’t know if I’d ever worked with but…
